articles.title: Feds open probe into Musk’s steering-wheel-free taxis a day after he began offering rides in them
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Federal regulators are opening an investigation into whether Tesla's new steering-wheel-free taxis comply with safety rules a day after the company began offering rides in the vehicles.

articles.title: Inside Canadian newsrooms’ triumphs — and regrets — while covering the 9/11 attacks
articles.summary: TORONTO — Like every other journalist working in a Canadian newsroom on Sept. 11, 2001, Michelle Shephard recalls the moment she learned a plane had struck the World Trade Center in New York City.

articles.title: Niagara to Toronto commuters frustrated by GO service cuts, persistent delays
articles.summary: Following schedule changes and some cuts made to several GO train routes this week, residents in Niagara, Ont. are speaking out about the overall unreliability of the service. Metrolinx says there are no changes to rush hour in Niagara as it completes important construction work, but commuters say constant delays this year have made the trips between Toronto and Niagara increasingly difficult.

articles.title: Vaughan cleans up after severe thunderstorm leaves trail of damage
articles.summary: Wednesday's severe thunderstorm left a trail of damage in Vaughan and crews are out in force to clean up its aftermath, Mayor Steven Del Duca says.

articles.title: Video shows 2 workers escaping moving scaffold during thunderstorm
articles.summary: Dramatic video captures two workers escaping a moving scaffold on a building in Toronto's Yorkville neighbourhood during Wednesday's storm

articles.title: NDP takes Scarborough Southwest, PCs win in York—Simcoe, Hamilton East—Stoney Creek byelections
articles.summary: Ontario's Progressive Conservatives held onto the ridings of York-Simcoe and Hamilton East-Stoney Creek, while the NDP maintained its grip on Scarborough Southwest in three provincial byelections held Thursday.

articles.title: Man charged in connection to fatal Scarborough car crash in May: police
articles.summary: Toronto police have arrested and charged a 39-year-old man from Pickering, Ont. in connection to a fatal Scarborough car crash in May that killed one person and put three others in hospital.

articles.title: Complaints about drug use, violence persist at Barbara Hall Park as Toronto considers its response
articles.summary: A Toronto city task force meant to address ongoing issues at Barbara Hall Park is expected to revisit its approach amid ongoing complaints about public drug use and violence in the area.
